name: official-seed-compound-hairpin-evidence-v1

binding.reason: The run JSON identifies policy kind/name and its first action matches the current 0.11 launch behavior, but it contains no source, agent, model, or package hash.

runs.collision_qualification: The only collision was at step 49, about 13 seconds before the terminal road loss, so it is not a common terminal cause.

facts: All three runs terminate by the official 101-negative-action off-track mechanism after the road disappears from the controller, not by the five-collision limit.
All three top-down traces show an obstacle before a tight hairpin, an outside pass, and departure over the outside edge while steering unwinds from a substantial turn command to nearly zero.
The telemetry velocity magnitude is approximately 29 to 30 at the final valid-road action in all three runs.
The current launch-only 0.11 factor is inactive in the compound hazard because the road is not classified straight and an obstacle is detected.
hypotheses: The existing transient compound target of 30 leaves insufficient lateral margin for an outside obstacle pass into a tight hairpin.
Steering release and the subsequent road-loss fallback also contribute, so a lower target is not established as the sole cause or a guaranteed repair.
limitations: The embedded images are top-down diagnostic renders, not the 4x84x84 policy observations.
The telemetry records world velocity and emitted actions but not the controller's estimated speed, detected obstacle tuple, raw road centers, raw curve target, or internal state.
The exact global hairpin angle and map labels must not enter runtime policy logic.
These three consumed runs cannot confirm a candidate motivated by them and cannot be used as fresh confirmation or blind evidence.
